title: Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer (AWS)
description:
Overview

Oowlish, one of Latin America's rapidly expanding software development companies, is seeking experienced technology professionals to enhance our diverse and vibrant team.

As a valued member of Oowlish, you will collaborate with premier clients from the United States and Europe, contributing to pioneering digital solutions. Our commitment to creating a nurturing work environment is recognized by our certification as a Great Place to Work, where you will have opportunities for professional development, growth, and a chance to make a significant international impact. We offer the convenience of remote work, allowing you to craft a work-life balance that suits your personal and professional needs. We are looking for candidates who are passionate about technology, proficient in English, and excited to engage in remote collaboration for a worldwide presence.

Role Overview

We are seeking a Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer to lead the design, build, and operation of scalable, secure, and reliable cloud infrastructure across AWS and Heroku. This role is infrastructure-first: you will own cloud foundations, networking, automation, and operational excellence while partnering closely with application and platform teams. You will be expected to make pragmatic architectural decisions, lead hands-on implementation efforts, improve reliability and cost efficiency, and raise the overall cloud maturity of the organization across both IaaS and PaaS environments.

Responsibilities

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience building and operating cloud infrastructure in production (AWS and/or Heroku)
  • Strong experience managing large, distributed systems using Infrastructure as Code
  • Deep understanding of AWS core services (EC2, VPC, ELB/ALB/NLB, S3, RDS, IAM, Lambda)
  • Strong hands-on experience operating applications and infrastructure on Heroku, including pipelines, add-ons, scaling, runtime tuning, and production operations
  • Strong operating system fundamentals and debugging skills
  • Solid networking knowledge: routing, IP addressing, DNS, L4 vs L7 load balancing, VPNs, traceroute
  • Experience implementing private connectivity (e.g., AWS PrivateLink, VPC peering, or equivalent)
  • Proficiency with containers and orchestration platforms (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Experience with scripting and automation (Python, Bash, or similar)
  • Proven ability to troubleshoot complex infrastructure, platform, and production issues
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

Benefits

  • Home office
  • Competitive compensation based on experience
  • Career plans to allow for extensive growth in the company
  • International Projects
  • Oowlish English Program (Technical and Conversational)
  • Oowlish Fitness with Total Pass
  • Games and Competitions

description:

Visão geral

Em Tech Financial Services (Tech FSO), estamos construindo um mundo de negócios melhor apoiando as necessidades e desafios tecnológicos dos nossos clientes do segmento financeiro (Mercado de Capitais, Bancos, Fintechs, Seguros e Gestão de Ativos). #TechEY

Qual será o seu papel nesse propósito?

Como Analista em Governança de Dados você irá atuar em cliente de grande porte, com oportunidade de crescimento em frentes diversas na área de dados voltados para o segmento financeiro. Você poderá contar com ferramentas, conhecimentos e oportunidades para avançar e estar pronto/a para construir um mundo de negócios melhor para nossas pessoas, clientes e as comunidades que nos apoiam.

Por que você?

Se você é apaixonado(a) por dados, colaboração e tem as seguintes qualificações, queremos você em nossa equipe!

  • Formação completa/cursando nas áreas de Tecnologia, Ciências da Computação, Análise de Sistemas, Matemática, Estatística, Engenharias e ou correlatas;
  • Experiência com Governança de Dados, LGPD e princípios DAMA-DMBOK;
  • Conhecimento em Cloud (AWS/ Azure/ GCP) para integração com catálogo/linhagem
  • Databricks Unity Catalog, IBM Data Catalog ou Azure Puview EDC Apache Atlas Erwin Data Quality/MDM: Informatica, Talend ou Ataccama Data Quality/MDM: Informatica, Talend, Ataccama (diferencial);
  • Experiência com linguagens SQL e Python;
  • Governança de IA/IA Generativa
  • Inglês intermediário será considerado um diferencial.
  • Certificações: DCAM, DAMA CDMP, Collibra Ranger/Administrator, Alation, LGPD/DPO, ITIL/ISO 27001 (Diferencial).

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Definir e operacionalizar políticas/procedimentos de governança de dados (acesso, qualidade, lineage, metadados);
  • Estruturar glossário de negócios, domínios e papéis (owners/stewards);
  • Implantar ferramentas de catálogo/linhagem (Collibra, Alation, Atlas, Informatica);
  • Desenhar e monitorar indicadores de qualidade (DQ Rules, SLAs, scorecards);

About Canals

Canals is a fully remote, profitable startup transforming the industrial supply chain ($10T industry) with AI. Our platform seamlessly integrates with the systems distributors already use, automating tedious tasks and reducing failure points in moving physical goods across the globe.

We’re an 80-person team (~50 in engineering), located across North and South America.

The Role

We’re hiring a Technical Support Agent to help distributors get fast, effective support as they scale on Canals. Our customers rely on our platform for mission‑critical workflows — and maintaining a 1‑minute average response time is part of what sets our team apart. You’ll troubleshoot technical issues, guide users through our tools, and collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to ensure a seamless customer experience. You’ll also gain exposure to the systems that power our platform — working with tools like Zendesk, Postman, FullStory, and SQL to diagnose and resolve issues.

If you’re a sharp communicator with strong technical instincts and love solving problems quickly and clearly, this role is for you.

  • Respond to customer inquiries via live chat and email, maintaining our 1‑minute average first response time.
  • Troubleshoot product and integration issues, escalating when needed to Support Engineers or Product.
  • Use Postman to test API endpoints and SQL to run basic queries for debugging or validation.
  • Investigate customer behavior and issues using FullStory session data.
  • Collaborate closely with CSMs and the Solutions team to ensure smooth onboarding and post‑launch support.
  • Document resolutions and update internal Zendesk macros and knowledge base articles.
  • Identify recurring issues and propose process or product improvements.

What You’ll Bring

  • Typically, 1–3 years of experience in technical support for a SaaS product.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills — you explain technical issues clearly and concisely.
  • Ability to translate complex topics for non‑technical users.
  • Highly organized, proactive, and comfortable in a fast‑moving startup environment.
  • A genuine sense of urgency — you take pride in speed and quality.

Bonus Points

  • You’ve used tools like Postman, Zendesk, or FullStory to diagnose and resolve issues.
  • You’ve worked in a startup or early‑stage environment and helped shape support processes or playbooks.
  • You have experience supporting non‑technical customers in industrial, logistics, or distribution contexts.
  • You’ve built or refined internal support workflows, macros, or dashboards.

Why Join Canals

  • Real‑world impact: your work improves global supply chains, saving customers time and reducing waste.
  • Strong engineering culture: we invest in quality and documentation to keep moving fast sustainably.
  • Culture of ownership: moving fast while putting quality first.
  • Remote‑first, flexible work environment across North and South America.
  • Stellar product‑market fit with tons of customer love.
  • All star team with diverse backgrounds to collaborate with and learn from.

title: Brazil Hull Plan Approval Engineer
description:
RINA is currently recruiting for a Brazil Hull Plan Approval Engineer to join its office in Rio de Janeiro within the Latin America Marine Division .

Mission

This role focuses on performing detailed plan and design reviews, resolving issues related to conflicting design requirements, ensuring client requirements and applicable standards are met. Projects could include the approval of new building, conversion, and existing vessels and yachts.

Key Accountabilities

  • Review and approve hull structural drawings of ships, offshore units, and marine equipment, in compliance with Class Rules and Statutory Regulations, for new buildings, ships in service, and ship’s conversions.
  • Assist clients during the design and construction phase, providing guidance and support related to structural design.
  • Resolve issues related to conflicting design requirements and material standards.
  • Perform assessments and provide specialist advice for service delivery, research or development work within agreed broad parameters that include budget constraints and contractual requirements.
  • Oversee and manage day-to-day project elements, visit sites to take measurements.
  • Ensure correct and up-to-date data is used and complete documentation is submitted to officials and other day-to-day duties.
  • Review the project deliverables (technical reports, project performance documentations and engineering drawings, etc.).
  • Review progress reports and take appropriate action to ensure requirements are met.
  • Take ownership and responsibility over the financial progress of assigned tasks.
  • Understand and apply project management concepts providing feedback to project manager, serve as reference for the escalation of issues.
  • Manage simple and complex projects assigned applying project management concepts and techniques.
  • Assess complex structural problems for internal/external clients to determine solutions.
  • Answer complex contractor questions on behalf of the supervising engineer, and serve as liaisons between engineering and construction personnel.

Education

Bachelor’s Degree in Naval Engineering

Qualifications

  • Experience:
    • Experience in hull design, shipbuilding, or marine engineering, with a focus on plan approval in a Class Society or shipbuilding environment.
    • Experience in the review and approval of hull structural designs, stability calculations, and material selection, ensuring compliance with applicable rules and regulations.
    • Practical experience working with international maritime standards (SOLAS, MARPOL, etc.) and Class Society regulations.
    • In-depth experience in the hull plan approval process, including structural integrity verification, load distribution, and strength calculations.
  • Technical Skills:
    • Advanced understanding of ship hull design principles, structural components, and materials used in hull construction.
    • Expertise in reviewing technical drawings, specifications, and stability calculations for hull structures to ensure compliance with design codes and Class Society standards.
    • Proficiency in software tools commonly used in hull plan approval and structural analysis, such as AutoCAD, NAPA, ShipConstructor, or other naval architecture and engineering software.
    • In-depth knowledge of materials used in hull construction, including steel grades, welding techniques, and corrosion protection methods.

Additional Information

  • Office located in Centro (RJ).
  • Hybrid work regime (after first period 100% on site).
  • All of our positions are also available to people with disabilities (PwD / PCD).

Competencies

  • WORKPLACE DYNAMICS - Resourcefulness in shaping progress and working efficiently.
  • FORESIGHT & INSIGHT - Context awareness adopting a systemic perspective and informed decision making.
  • PERSONAL EMPOWERMENT - Ownership for life, work and results, striving to grow professionally and personally.
  • INTERPERSONAL INFLUENCE - Skills and strategies we use to interact effectively with others.
  • DOMAIN & BUSINESS ACUMEN - Applying a scientific approach and critical thinking in operations and solution development within area of expertise.

At RINA, we endeavor to create a work environment where every single person is valued and encouraged to develop new ideas. We provide equal employment opportunities and are committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels respected and safe from discrimination or harassment of any kind. We are also compliant to the Italian Law n. 68/99.

Info on the Account Executive (Strategic Accounts & Partnerships)

We are looking for a strategic, consultative, and results‑driven Account Executive to act as a trusted partner to our most important North American clients and strategic partners. In this role, you will directly support the Chief Technology Solutions & Advisory Officer in driving new sales, expanding existing accounts, and strengthening Ubiminds’ ecosystem of strategic partners across advisory, consulting, and Talent‑as‑a‑Service engagements.

This is a high‑visibility, high‑impact role focused on accelerating revenue growth through consultative selling, account expansion, and partner collaboration. You will own the full client and partner lifecycle — from identifying new business opportunities and shaping partnership strategies to delivering Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and Partner Business Reviews (PBRs) that reinforce Ubiminds’ position as a premier nearshore provider of Advisory, Consulting, and Talent‑as‑a‑Service solutions.

You will play a key role in building long‑term partnerships that generate mutual value, strengthen go‑to‑market collaboration, and expand our presence within strategic accounts and partner ecosystems.

What You’ll Do as Account Executive at Ubiminds

Strategic Account Leadership & Growth

Partner directly with the Chief Technology Solutions & Advisory Officer to develop and execute account strategies aligned with client business goals and long‑term growth opportunities.

Drive revenue growth through proactive new business development, upselling, renewals, and scope expansion across advisory, consulting, and Talent‑as‑a‑Service engagements.

Identify and close new opportunities within existing clients, positioning Ubiminds as a strategic partner capable of delivering high‑value consulting and nearshore solutions.

Collaborate with internal stakeholders to align client needs with Ubiminds’ advisory capabilities, delivery expertise, and long‑term partnership strategy.

Client Excellence & Advisory Partnership Management

Establish and monitor strategic KPIs aligned with advisory and consulting engagements, ensuring measurable value delivery to clients.

Lead the preparation and delivery of Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), presenting strategic insights, value delivered, and opportunities for expansion.

Strengthen executive relationships with client stakeholders, reinforcing Ubiminds’ positioning as a consultative and trusted advisor.

Promote continuous improvement initiatives that enhance client satisfaction, long‑term retention, and partnership value.

Strategic Partner Relationship Management

Serve as the relationship owner for assigned strategic partners, including nearshore talent partners, technology partners, and ecosystem collaborators.

Align partner initiatives with Ubiminds’ go‑to‑market strategy, identifying opportunities for co‑selling, joint solution development, and mutual growth.

Collaborate with partners to develop integrated offerings that strengthen Ubiminds’ advisory and consulting value proposition.

Lead partner business reviews (PBRs), presenting insights on joint performance, value delivered, and opportunities for partnership expansion.

Identify, qualify, and onboard new partners that strengthen Ubiminds’ ecosystem and expand our ability to serve North American clients.

Track and monitor partner‑related KPIs such as joint revenue contribution, partner satisfaction, and co‑selling effectiveness.

Contract & Partnership Oversight

Manage and oversee partner and client agreements (MSAs, SOWs, amendments, and partnership addendums) in collaboration with legal and operations teams.

Ensure contract accuracy, compliance, and alignment with strategic growth initiatives.

Drive timely renewals, contract expansions, and new agreements that support long‑term client and partner success.

Cross‑Functional Collaboration

Act as a bridge between clients, partners, and internal teams to ensure alignment, transparency, and seamless collaboration across the ecosystem.

Partner with Sales, Delivery, Legal, and Finance teams to ensure consistency in positioning, contracting, and execution of advisory and consulting engagements.

Contribute insights that support continuous improvement of Ubiminds’ go‑to‑market approach and partnership strategy.

Mandatory Skills:

5+ years of experience in account management, strategic sales, client success, or business development within IT staffing, nearshore/outsourcing, consulting, or professional services environments.

Proven track record of driving new sales, account expansion, and long‑term client growth.

Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship‑building skills.

Strong analytical and problem‑solving abilities, with focus on revenue growth and partnership value creation.

Experience working with Latin America nearshore talent models or international outsourcing environments.

Background in technology consulting, AI solutions, or software development services.

Experience in partner/channel management or alliance ecosystems.

Existing network within nearshore, consulting, or professional services ecosystems.

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).

As an Account Executive at Ubiminds, you will:

Work in a fast‑paced and innovative environment, interacting with leaders of industry‑leading companies.

Be part of strategic conversations that directly impact company growth and international expansion.

Choose to work remotely or at our office – we are a distributed team, after all.

description:
Job type: Full-time employee Full-time employee

Somos mais de 12 mil colaboradores e convivemos em uma instituição que valoriza o trabalhador e a diversidade. Ética, respeito e excelência na gestão fazem parte da missão do Seconci-SP. Temos como princípio oferecer um atendimento humanizado e de qualidade, pois trabalhamos com um bem extremamente precioso: a Saúde.

Venha trabalhar conosco e fazer parte de uma equipe que tem o compromisso de salvar vidas e construir o Brasil.

  • Aplicar oxigenoterapia ou nebulização, conforme prescrição médica, seguindo padrões e normas técnicas estabelecidas.
  • Auxiliar nas ações e eventos de promoção e prevenção de saúde, sob supervisão do enfermeiro, disseminando informações importantes e incentivando as ações de saúde.
  • Executar atividade de limpeza, desinfecção e esterilização de artigos e equipamentos, bem como sua reposição, conservação, preparo, armazenamento e manutenção, segundo as normas técnicas.
  • Observar, reconhecer e descrever sinais e sintomas, ao nível de sua qualificação, verificando e controlando sinais vitais, comunicando alterações ao enfermeiro.
  • Preparar o paciente para consultas, exames e tratamento, a fim de garantir que o mesmo esteja em condições ideais para a realização do procedimento em questão.
  • Realizar procedimentos de enfermagem, exames, e/ou vacinas, conforme orientação do enfermeiro e prescrição médica, atuando na unidade e/ou ambientes externos, seguindo rotinas e protocolos da unidade.
  • Vivência em Sala de Vacina é um diferencial.
  • Vale Alimentação
  • Refeitório Local
  • Auxílio Creche
  • Seguro de Vida em Grupo
  • Incentivo a Educação/Universidades

Conheça o Seconci-SP

O Seconci-SP - Serviço Social da Construção Civil do Estado de São Paulo é uma entidade filantrópica, sem fins lucrativos, fundada em março de 1964 por um grupo de empresários do setor para atender aos trabalhadores da construção e seus familiares. Com sede na capital, o Seconci-SP mantém outras 12 Unidades Ambulatoriais no Estado de São Paulo, que realizam at endimentos médico-ambulatoriais, odontológicos, exames, serviços complementares e de apoio.

GESTÃO INTEGRADA DE SAÚDE E SEGURANÇA DO TRABALHO

Além da assistência prestada ao trabalhador da construção civil, o Seconci-SP, há mais de 25 anos assessora empresas de todos os setores/segmentos na gestão integrada de Saúde e Segurança do Trabalho (SST).

Conta com profissionais experientes e altamente qualificados em sua equipe própria, formada por médicos do trabalho, engenheiros e técnicos de segurança, além de especialistas com notório reconhecimento no mercado.

Um outro importante diferencial: o Seconci-SP trabalha com o Sistema SOC, líder de mercado na área de gestão de SST.

O Seconci-SP auxilia as empresas na implantação e implementação de ações preventivas, visando a melhoria da qualidade de vida dos trabalhadores, o aumento da produtividade e a redução dos custos operacionais.

ORGANIZAÇÃO SOCIAL DE SAÚDE - OSS

Por sua grande experiência na atenção à saúde e por já atuar como parceiro do Estado de São Paulo, retirando das filas do SUS milhares de usuários, o Seconci-SP foi convidado em 1998, a participar de processo de qualificação da primeira geração de Organizações Sociais de Saúde (OSS) do País. Para assumir a gestão de equipamentos de saúde em parceria com o Estado e Munícipio de São Paulo.

title: Head Jurídico (Regulatório, Contratos e Compliance)
description:
Head Jurídico (Regulatório, Contratos e Compliance)

A Bankme é uma techfin que combina duas verticais estratégicas: uma plataforma SaaS para operacionalização de banqueiros independentes (Mini Bancos) e uma securitizadora regulada, que estrutura operações de crédito, FIDCs e debêntures para seus clientes e investidores.

Atuamos em um ambiente altamente regulado – CVM, BACEN, COAF e ANBIMA – onde a estruturação jurídica é um elemento crítico para viabilizar operações com segurança, eficiência e escala.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Head Jurídico para atuar como principal referência em direito regulatório e contratos financeiros dentro da Bankme. Essa posição terá papel central na estruturação e validação de produtos, mitigação de riscos regulatórios e relacionamento com órgãos reguladores, atuando de forma próxima ao CEO, CFO e Conselho de Administração.

Além disso, será responsável por liderar a evolução da frente de compliance da companhia, garantindo aderência regulatória e sustentação das operações em um ambiente altamente regulado.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Regulatório & Produtos

  • Atuar como especialista interno em regulamentação aplicável ao mercado financeiro e de capitais, incluindo CVM (Resoluções 60 e 175), BACEN e Lei 14.430 (Securitização) e Lei 6.404 (S/A).
  • Estruturar juridicamente produtos financeiros de crédito, especialmente Mini Bancos via operações envolvendo FIDCs e debêntures securitizáveis.
  • Conduzir análises de viabilidade regulatória para novos modelos de operação, reduzindo fragilidades jurídicas e dependência de pareceres externos.
  • Identificar oportunidades dentro do ambiente regulatório que viabilizem novas estruturas de negócio.
  • Garantir o enquadramento contínuo das operações às normas da CVM, BACEN e COAF.
  • Acompanhar mudanças regulatórias e antecipar impactos no modelo de negócio.

Contratos Financeiros & Operações

  • Redigir, revisar e negociar contratos de alta complexidade (debêntures, FIDCs, cessão de crédito e parcerias financeiras).
  • Atuar na estruturação de operações com patrimônio segregado (Lei 14.430), como argumento de proteção a investidores e instrumento de fechamento comercial.
  • Apoiar o time comercial com visão jurídica aplicada às negociações de forma a reduzir objeções de clientes.
  • Gerenciar e orientar escritórios externos, garantindo entregas alinhadas com o modelo de negócio da companhia.
  • Liderar a frente de Compliance, com potencial evolução para representação formal perante órgãos reguladores conforme a maturidade da estrutura.
  • Garantir a elegibilidade de cedentes e investidores.
  • Revisar e aprovar políticas internas, código de conduta e diretrizes de risco.
  • Atuar junto ao Comitê de Riscos e ao Conselho em temas regulatórios.
  • Conduzir ou supervisionar auditorias internas de enquadramento e responder a solicitações de órgãos reguladores.

Relação Institucional

  • Atuar como ponto de contato com órgãos reguladores (CVM, BACEN, ANBIMA e COAF).
  • Apoiar a estruturação de operações junto às áreas internas como referência jurídica e regulatória.
  • Colaborar com o CFO na estruturação de operações que envolvam captação, emissão e distribuição de valores mobiliários.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação em Direito com OAB ativa e sem restrições.
  • Experiência sólida (mín. 8 anos) em direito financeiro, regulatório ou mercado de capitais, com passagem por escritório/setor especializado em mercado de capitais, securitizadora, FIDC, fintech ou área jurídica interna de instituição financeira.
  • Experiência sólida em legislação aplicada ao mercado financeiro: Lei 14.430 (incluindo regime de afetação e patrimônio segregado), Resoluções CVM 175, normas BACEN (aplicadas a fintechs, IPs e SCDs), normas COAF e ANBIMA.
  • Vivência prática com estruturação de FIDCs (cotas, cessão, elegibilidade, concentração, inadimplência), debêntures, securitização ou fintechs.
  • Experiência com regimes de patrimônio segregado e estruturação contratual de operações financeiras complexas.
  • Vivência sólida em PLD-FT, AML, KYC e frameworks de compliance para mercado financeiro, como gestor ou supervisor.
  • Experiência em elaboração e revisão de instrumentos de dívida e valores mobiliários.
  • Domínio de regulamentações aplicáveis (CVM, BACEN, COAF, ANBIMA).

Diferenciais

  • Pós-graduação ou especialização em Direito Financeiro ou Mercado de Capitais.
  • Experiência com relacionamento institucional com reguladores.
  • Vivência em ambientes de crescimento acelerado (fintechs / startups).
  • Mentalidade de “engenheiro jurídico”: busca caminhos dentro das regras, com foco em geração de receita.
  • Comunicação clara, objetiva e orientada ao negócio.
  • Capacidade de atuar com autonomia e protagonismo.
  • Conforto com ambientes em estruturação e crescimento acelerado.
